page.layout: One page of text: running head at top; a heading across the top; a woodcut illustration in the middle; a verse epigram in italic lines below it; a catchword-like word "Mare" at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Viator ventum flantem obiecto pallio inhibere studens. XXI.

p.i: [woodcut illustration: a traveller with a cloak held against the wind, trees and rocks]

main_text.p: QVis sapere hunc credat, sese qui posse [?] retandis

l.i: Stultior at quanto est sese qui posse loquentis

page.notes: The woodcut is an engraving of a man with a cloak opposing wind, with trees and rocks; described, not transcribed. The first line of the epigram is partly unclear: "posse" and the following word "Vetandis" (possibly "Vetandis" or "Retandis") are doubtful and marked. The word "Mare" at lower right is a catchword-like element; its status is uncertain.
